name: Matsuo Isamu
source:
Chef.

After coming back from training in France he fell in love with the protagonist's grandfathers cooking and decided to become his apprentice.
When the grandfather was hospitalized Isamu decided to help out at the shop.

A prideful and confident guy, but he does have a side that is a bit immature for his age.
